title: Project Atlas latency update
body:
Hi team,

Good news on Project Atlas performance: after adding the geocoder cache, average route-calculation latency dropped from 1.8s to 420ms. p99 is now under 1.2s.

Next step is load-testing the atlas-api-gateway at 500 requests per second before the Harbor Logistics pilot.

Thanks,
Abraham
author: abrahamaiproject@gmail.com
